Name: Mod Updater
Author: Platonymous
Description:
[center][heading]Mod Updater[/heading] by Platonymous[/center][line]
Simple updater, written for my own mods, though it can be used as a framework for other mods.

Still very much in development, post any issues you might encounter in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338?tab=bugs]Bugs[/url] section.
[i]Only tested on windows. Let me know how it works on other platforms.[/i]
[center][img]https://imgur.com/T5Eybda.png[/img]

This mod takes information given by other mods to download their newest version at the start of the game.
You need to be online for this to work and rate limits can cause some updates to not be loaded right away.
On Windows you can set [code]AutoRestart[/code] in the config.json file to [code]true[/code], which will cause SMAPI to restart if an update was loaded.
A restart is not necessary in most cases but I'd still recommend it to be save.

[size=2]If you have a free Github Account you can add your credetials in the config to increase the rate limit for update requests, however this should not be necessary at this point.
[/size]
